notes: F-META-004 / ABI-2.1-2.4 + ABI-3.3: Core 1.0 defines no stable ABI; the only contract is source semantics, and --emit-rust is auditable (each emitted item carries a `// rv: file:line` mapping). Absence of extern/repr/unsafe in the generated file cannot be asserted by the harness (no negative substring assertion); it is reported as a limitation.
